findings.statement: After zero b_i rows are omitted in the product-projection proof, the retained sum satisfies sum_{b_i>0}(1-b_i)<=d, not equality. The needed upper bound and all constants are unchanged.
At inspection the manuscript root lacked SOURCE_MANIFEST.json, proof_map.csv, verify.py, and checks.json although README names them; the symbolic manuscript proof is self-contained.
The graph-BL Jacobian, c_j/d_i frame weights, entropy term, alpha=(2*pi*e)^2 regularizer cancellation, and fourth-root determinant exponent -1/8 were independently reconstructed and found correct.
For fixed rank r, retuning the scalar BL regularizer alpha cannot improve the asymptotic determinant-route exponent beyond |phi(t)|~|t|^{-r/4}; at r=4 the endpoint remains 1/|t|.

For U,V iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2], Q0=2UV has p(q)=log(1/(2|q|)) on |q|<1/2, hence unbounded density, while phi(t)=2 Si(t/2)/t=O(1/t) and sup_a E|Q0-a|^{-1/2}<infinity. Thus borderline k=4 Fourier decay plus an abstract half-potential bound cannot alone imply L-infinity. This is not a counterexample to the fixed-multiplicity theorem because Q0 has only two large eigenvalues.
